items.title: Dictionary review
items.description: Search a term, read its definition, synonyms and explanation, then bookmark it for later review.

items.title: 3D anatomy review
items.description: Use the local WebGL anatomy workspace to inspect body layers, named structures and saved views.

items.title: Conditions review
items.description: Browse short educational condition summaries by specialty.

items.title: Procedures review
items.description: Review high-level descriptions of common diagnostic and clinical procedures.

items.title: Physiology formula tools
items.description: Use numeric formula tools without diagnostic interpretation.

items.title: Offline Study Engine
items.description: Create local explanations, comparisons, flashcards, quizzes and summaries from bundled reference data with no cloud service.

items.title: Bookmarks & saved views
items.description: Revisit bookmarked dictionary terms and saved anatomy views on this device.

items.title: Optional free cloud AI
items.description: When a free provider is configured, the study workspace can optionally request generative answers. The app never enables a paid fallback.
